column1: # SP-PROOF kit: W7 SP-OOHH lane, flag-OFF bit-identity proof.
# With spacing_oohh disabled, every style is off-target: the candidate build
# must reproduce the base build byte-for-byte on all three styles below.
# When the same harness later proves the flag-ON lane, flip the styles the
# layer intentionally touches to `on-target` and keep the rest off-target.
# Columns: style_id <TAB> family <TAB> subfamily <TAB> manifest_relpath <TAB> out_relpath <TAB> scope
# manifest_relpath resolves against $KNI_G_FIXTURES (never a hardcoded path);
# out_relpath is the style out-dir under each run root; the font file is
# font-<style_id>.otf by the pipeline's own naming rule.
# style_id values are file-name safe (pipeline validate_style_id).
